verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration platform with a catalog of 1200+ integrations plus custom and remote MCP servers, so security scanning of listed servers is a fair axis. The pack only shows governance controls applied after an admin decides what to allow: approved integrations in portals, tool filters, version pinning, RBAC/SSO, and after-the-fact traces. Nothing shows the platform scanning or inspecting servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before agents use them.
